purpose: Cases the domain is expected to handle within its declared scope. Loading may or may not change the final answer; each case describes the judgment the domain should express and the boundary it should respect.

cases.title: Most common task in your domain
cases.input: [paste the user prompt that triggers your domain's typical task]
cases.expected_without_kdna: [what an equally capable agent says without this domain — it may reach the same conclusion; write 'unspecified' when no baseline answer was observed]
cases.expected_with_kdna: [what this domain's declared judgment produces — root cause / specific terminology / boundary awareness; it may match the unloaded answer and still be correct]
must_not_contain: generic advice phrase you want to avoid

cases.title: A case requiring the agent to apply an axiom non-obviously
